title: An LLM-Agentic Framework for Intelligent Work Order Management in Industrial Maintenance
abstract: arXiv:2611.25070v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents an AI-driven framework, CodeReAct agent, designed to enhance industrial equipment maintenance through natural language (NL) interactions. The framework employs an advanced AI agentic approach to interpret human instructions, providing knowledge extraction, asset status summarization, and work order recommendations. It identifies patterns and trends and predicts work orders by standardizing industrial data into business objects (BOs) and utilizing analytical function API calls. The AI agent operates through a Thought-Action-Observation process similar to human problem-solving, automating complex analytical tasks typically performed by data scientists. Notably, the Action phase generates executable code, replacing manual coding efforts. translated_title: 一种基于大语言模型智能体的工业维护智能工单管理框架
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种人工智能驱动的框架——CodeReAct智能体，旨在通过自然语言（NL）交互来增强工业设备维护能力。该框架采用先进的AI智能体方法来解析人类指令，提供知识提取、资产状态汇总和工单推荐功能。它通过将工业数据标准化为业务对象（BOs）并利用分析函数API调用，来识别模式与趋势并预测工单。该AI智能体通过类似人类解决问题的“思考-行动-观察”流程运行，将通常由数据科学家执行的复杂分析任务自动化。值得注意的是，其行动阶段会生成可执行代码，从而取代人工编码工作。一项聚焦于冷水机组维护的案例研究展示了该框架分析多年工单数据的能力，并呈现了警报与异常情况。结果表明……
tldr: 本文提出了CodeReAct智能体框架，通过自然语言交互、将工业数据标准化为业务对象并自动生成可执行代码，实现了工业设备维护中知识提取、资产状态汇总与工单预测的智能化管理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CodeReAct, an LLM-agentic framework that automates intelligent work order management in industrial maintenance through natural language interaction, standardizing industrial data into business objects and generating executable code for knowledge extraction, asset status summarization, and work order prediction.
